statement: The CISA KEV catalog will add a Cisco-vendor entry with dateAdded between 2026-09-21 and 2026-10-05.
resolution: True if CISA's KEV catalog lists an entry with vendorProject Cisco and dateAdded between 2026-09-21 and 2026-10-05, checked 2026-10-08.
failure_condition: No Cisco-vendor entry with dateAdded in that window appears in the CISA KEV catalog by the deadline.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.
